notes: 54-segment doc is a mashup of video transcripts (creator economy/AI business how-to, cinematography instruction) plus Reddit thread scrapes. 60-70% boilerplate (timestamps, UI chrome, sponsor copy, fragmented speech). Signal is real but scattered across domains. Two primary usable domains extracted below: (1) AI business/monetization doctrine and (2) cinematography/lighting framework canon. Neither domain is SNIPED-specific; both are source-level intel that feeds the OS.

domain_A_ai_business_systems.label: AI Business and Monetization Operating Doctrine
domain_A_ai_business_systems.skills_over_models_philosophy: Never position on a specific AI model or AI buzzwords in pitches or content. Compete on capability, speed, and outcome. The model is infrastructure; the skill is the moat.
domain_A_ai_business_systems.pitch_structure: Four load-bearing elements only: market size, team credibility, clear pain, and proof of progress. AI is a tool, not the pitch. Replace 'we use AI' with 'here is what we built and what it already did.'
domain_A_ai_business_systems.idea_validation_filter: Three-gate screen before building: Scalable (can it grow without linear labor?), Simple (can it be explained in one sentence?), Suitable (does it match the founder's existing strengths and context?). All three gates required.
seven_step_ai_business_playbook: 1. Validate via Scalable/Simple/Suitable filter before spending any time.
2. Brand rapidly with AI tools (logo, name, basic identity in one session).
3. Deploy lightweight website via HubSpot or equivalent no-code tool.
4. Automate multi-platform content distribution via Zapier or equivalent.
5. B2B lead generation via Apollo or equivalent (build a targeted list first).
6. Automate client onboarding (intake form, contract, payment, welcome sequence).
7. 1% rule: weekly micro-optimization of one system component, compounding over time.
five_ai_income_streams: Etsy digital products (AI-generated printables, templates, planners).
Print-on-demand: build a base product, generate variations at scale via AI; sell without holding inventory.
Instagram theme pages: content automation via scheduling tools; monetize via brand deals or affiliate.
AI knowledge products: courses, guides, templates teaching AI workflows.
AI freelancing: sell outcomes (copy, design, automation builds) to businesses; never sell 'AI' as the product.

local_services_b2b_model.target: Home services and professional services (HVAC, roofing, law, dental, med spa).
local_services_b2b_model.pricing: $5,000-$10,000 upfront for AI system build + $500/month retainer for maintenance.
local_services_b2b_model.acquisition: Facebook and Instagram video ads targeting local zip codes.
local_services_b2b_model.lead_followup: AI caller (e.g. Sylow) handles inbound lead follow-up within 60 seconds; removes human bottleneck.
local_services_b2b_model.positioning: Sell the outcome (booked appointments, answered leads) not the technology.

outreach_mechanics.personalized_video_dms: Overcome DM noise by leading with a short loom/video that demonstrates you already know their work. Greg Eisenberg case: 175 personalized videos to journalists produced disproportionate response rate.
outreach_mechanics.cold_email_framing: Outcome-based subject lines only. Never reference AI as a feature. Frame result first, mechanism second.
outreach_mechanics.reddit_framing_rule: On Reddit and public forums: outcome-based framing beats AI-as-feature framing every time. State what changed for the user, not how you made it happen.

content_and_distribution.story_density_wins: AI-generated content competes and wins not via authenticity but via story density and information value per minute. Optimize for density of useful insight per unit of content.
content_and_distribution.phase_1_organic_to_paid: Build organic proof first, then boost with paid ($30/day desktop, 10-mile radius for local). Never pay to distribute content that has not already proven organic engagement.
content_and_distribution.creator_outreach_threshold: Eight creator interviews is the minimum threshold before an AI-native media brand can claim credibility. Quantity before quality perception.

domain_A_ai_business_systems.early_revenue_doctrine: First $1M milestone target is day 90. Revenue before polish. Proof before packaging. Ship a paying customer before optimizing the brand.
domain_A_ai_business_systems.print_on_demand_scaling: Template scaling strategy: one strong base product with five to ten AI-generated variations per theme. Each variation costs near zero; total catalog depth creates discoverability.
domain_A_ai_business_systems.consensus_llm_cost_benchmark: API cost benchmark (2024 reference): approximately 3 cents per consensus LLM call at mid-tier models. Use this for unit economics when pricing AI-augmented services.
domain_A_ai_business_systems.glp1_market_gap_intel: GLP-1 telehealth: NHS waiting list is 3x the size of the private market. Underserved demand. Applicable to any telemedicine vertical with public-system backlogs.

domain_B_cinematography_lighting.label: Cinematography and Lighting Framework Canon
domain_B_cinematography_lighting.core_doctrine: Upstage key lighting with framework principles produces superior results versus downstage or frontlit approaches. Master the framework deeply enough to break it intentionally when location or time requires.
framework_principles: L-shaped room or corner as default staging anchor for key light placement.
Shadow-side shooting: camera on the shadow side of the subject creates depth and dimension.
Edge separation: always maintain a visible edge or rim light to separate subject from background.
Backlit wide shots as a default opening frame; single-source bounce for intimacy.
Hard vs soft light by intent: hard light for structure and drama, soft light for skin and naturalism.
domain_B_cinematography_lighting.zone_control_model: Cinematography is zone management: key zone, fill zone, edge zone, background zone. Each zone is independently controlled. Never let zones bleed into each other unintentionally.
domain_B_cinematography_lighting.light_ratio_management: Beauty lighting and dark moody aesthetics use the same framework. Difficulty is ratio management and containment, not philosophical difference between looks.
domain_B_cinematography_lighting.production_time_allocation: 60% location scouting and production design, 30% lighting setup, 10% performance and talent direction. Most problems on set are pre-set problems.
domain_B_cinematography_lighting.sun_timing_and_wrapping: Sun wrap technique: use the natural falloff of golden hour backlight as a key light wrap around the subject. Time-sensitive; scout the sun angle before call time.
domain_B_cinematography_lighting.neg_diffusion_control: Negative fill (black flags) and diffusion are primary tools for controlling the fill side. Removing light is as important as adding it.
domain_B_cinematography_lighting.commercial_vs_narrative_aesthetics: Commercial work demands faster setup and cleaner separation. Narrative work allows more ratio latitude. Both use identical framework; execution speed and ratio tolerance differ.
domain_B_cinematography_lighting.crew_size_constraints: Smaller crews require setups that can be executed by two to three people. Framework lighting is scalable down; do not design setups that require a gaffer and two electric at minimum.
domain_B_cinematography_lighting.framework_as_permission_not_prison: The framework is not a formula. Mastery means internalizing the principles well enough that intentional deviation is a creative choice, not an accident or constraint failure.

creator_economy_case_intel.label: Creator Economy and Brand Case Intel (extractable tactics)
creator_economy_case_intel.monetization_stacking: Stack revenue streams on a single audience: brand partnerships + product sales + licensing + live events. Gary Vee model: never one revenue line from one platform.
creator_economy_case_intel.live_streaming_production: Blackboy Max model: live stream music production sessions to build audience while creating the product. The process IS the content. TVU backpack is the reliable field streaming hardware benchmark.
creator_economy_case_intel.niche_discovery_via_volume: Elias pet photography: 50,000 dog photos over 13 years built the niche credibility. Volume is the proof. Niche authority is not claimed; it is demonstrated through documented output.
creator_economy_case_intel.faze_house_chemistry_framework: Brand house chemistry: the group dynamic and interpersonal tension IS the content. Individual talent is secondary to group energy architecture.
creator_economy_case_intel.password_page_copy_psychology: Gated content access pages convert better when copy implies scarcity and insider status. Framing: 'you were sent here for a reason' outperforms generic 'enter password.'
creator_economy_case_intel.executive_producer_credit_as_leverage: Grammy nomination via executive producer credit: institutional recognition can be purchased or negotiated via credit structure. Apply to any credentialed industry where credit architecture is fungible.
creator_economy_case_intel.product_mockup_automation: Mockup region blend modes: use multiply or screen blend on smart object layers to achieve realistic surface texture integration at scale. Automate via Photoshop action or batch script.
